questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
questions.answer: I am Rohit Krishnan, a Java Developer with six years of experience. I have worked with Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, REST APIs and microservices. I have developed enterprise backend applications and worked with development and QA teams.

questions.question: Describe a challenging project you worked on.
questions.answer: I worked on an enterprise employee management platform. One challenge was maintaining communication between different backend services. I analyzed the service interactions, improved API integration and worked with the team to resolve the issue.

questions.question: How do you support junior developers?
questions.answer: I explain technical concepts, review their code and help them understand errors. I encourage them to investigate problems independently while providing guidance when needed.
